answer: Coordination Toll Ledger. Each agent identity opens a ledger that accrues a toll per pairwise interaction, settled in scarce compute credits drawn from a shared glacier of escrowed capacity. An attacker spinning N clones must fund N ledgers before any interaction clears, so the per-identity cost scales with coordination volume rather than registration. Idle clones still owe a dune of minimum holding rent each epoch, and a yarrow-indexed decay erases unused credit, forcing continuous payment. Cost to attacker: linear capital lockup plus rent for every clone kept live.
